limitations: Upstream: SLH-DSA sigGen FIPS205 AFT (signatureInterface=external, preHash=preHash, deterministic=true) → executed here: deterministic HashSLH-DSA SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKK_SLH_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk), C_SignInit(CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash>, CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED + upstream context), C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature. subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. No case is chosen by shortest message or any other tie-break because none is discarded. The two upstream hashAlg values with no PKCS#11 mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) are listed in notExecuted, as are the internal-interface groups, the external/pure groups (already carried by slhdsa_ctx_test.json and slhdsa_siggen_ctx0_test.json) and the deterministic=false preHash groups (the upstream additionalRandomness cannot be injected through CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT, so their signatures are not reproducible; hedged signing is exercised as a round-trip over this file's key material instead). One file per SLH-DSA hash family.

limitations: Upstream: SLH-DSA sigGen FIPS205 AFT (signatureInterface=external, preHash=preHash, deterministic=true) → executed here: deterministic HashSLH-DSA SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKK_SLH_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk), C_SignInit(CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash>, CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED + upstream context), C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature. subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. No case is chosen by shortest message or any other tie-break because none is discarded. The two upstream hashAlg values with no PKCS#11 mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) are listed in notExecuted, as are the internal-interface groups, the external/pure groups (already carried by slhdsa_ctx_test.json and slhdsa_siggen_ctx0_test.json) and the deterministic=false preHash groups (the upstream additionalRandomness cannot be injected through CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT, so their signatures are not reproducible; hedged signing is exercised as a round-trip over this file's key material instead). One file per SLH-DSA hash family.

subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. No case is chosen by shortest message or any other tie-break because none is discarded. limitations: Upstream: SLH-DSA sigGen FIPS205 AFT (signatureInterface=external, preHash=preHash, deterministic=true) → executed here: deterministic HashSLH-DSA SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKK_SLH_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk), C_SignInit(CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash>, CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED + upstream context), C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature. The same tuple also drives C_VerifyInit/C_Verify of the upstream signature, a CKH_HEDGE_REQUIRED sign+verify round-trip, and the message-based C_MessageSignInit/C_SignMessage + C_MessageVerifyInit/C_VerifyMessage pair.

subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. No case is chosen by shortest message or any other tie-break because none is discarded. The two upstream hashAlg values with no PKCS#11 mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) are listed in notExecuted, as are the internal-interface groups, the external/pure groups (already carried by slhdsa_ctx_test.json and slhdsa_siggen_ctx0_test.json) and the deterministic=false preHash groups (the upstream additionalRandomness cannot be injected through CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT, so their signatures are not reproducible; hedged signing is exercised as a round-trip over this file's key material instead). One file per SLH-DSA hash family.

limitations: Upstream: SLH-DSA sigGen FIPS205 AFT (signatureInterface=external, preHash=preHash, deterministic=true) → executed here: deterministic HashSLH-DSA SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKK_SLH_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk), C_SignInit(CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash>, CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED + upstream context), C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature. The same tuple also drives C_VerifyInit/C_Verify of the upstream signature, a CKH_HEDGE_REQUIRED sign+verify round-trip, and the message-based C_MessageSignInit/C_SignMessage + C_MessageVerifyInit/C_VerifyMessage pair.

subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. No case is chosen by shortest message or any other tie-break because none is discarded. The two upstream hashAlg values with no PKCS#11 mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) are listed in notExecuted, as are the internal-interface groups, the external/pure groups (already carried by slhdsa_ctx_test.json and slhdsa_siggen_ctx0_test.json) and the deterministic=false preHash groups (the upstream additionalRandomness cannot be injected through CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT, so their signatures are not reproducible; hedged signing is exercised as a round-trip over this file's key material instead). One file per SLH-DSA hash family.

subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. limitations: Upstream: SLH-DSA sigGen FIPS205 AFT (signatureInterface=external, preHash=preHash, deterministic=true) → executed here: deterministic HashSLH-DSA SigGen via PKCS#11: C_CreateObject(CKK_SLH_DSA, CKA_VALUE = upstream sk), C_SignInit(CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash>, CKH_DETERMINISTIC_REQUIRED + upstream context), C_Sign; output byte-compared to the upstream signature. The same tuple also drives C_VerifyInit/C_Verify of the upstream signature, a CKH_HEDGE_REQUIRED sign+verify round-trip, and the message-based C_MessageSignInit/C_SignMessage + C_MessageVerifyInit/C_VerifyMessage pair.
subset: 10 case(s) (upstream tcId 260, 261, 262, 263, 265, 266, 267, 268, 269, 270) taken from upstream tgId 30 (12 cases in that group; 624 in the upstream file).
field-drop: upstream fields not carried: deferred

subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and exhaustive over the dimension this file exists to close: every one of the 12 external/preHash deterministic=true groups (one per parameter set) contributes exactly the 10 cases whose hashAlg has a PKCS#11 v3.2 6.69.7 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism, i.e. all 10 x 12 = 120 (mechanism, parameter set) pairs the HashSLH-DSA capability cells enumerate. No case is chosen by shortest message or any other tie-break because none is discarded. The two upstream hashAlg values with no PKCS#11 mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) are listed in notExecuted, as are the internal-interface groups, the external/pure groups (already carried by slhdsa_ctx_test.json and slhdsa_siggen_ctx0_test.json) and the deterministic=false preHash groups (the upstream additionalRandomness cannot be injected through CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT, so their signatures are not reproducible; hedged signing is exercised as a round-trip over this file's key material instead). One file per SLH-DSA hash family.
A hedged row is a round-trip, not a byte-match: CKH_HEDGE_REQUIRED draws fresh randomness the NIST vector cannot pin, so those exercises carry functional-round-trip, not the case-level NIST class.

limitations: Upstream: SLH-DSA sigVer FIPS205 AFT (signatureInterface=external, preHash=preHash) → executed here: HashSLH-DSA SigVer via PKCS#11 C_VerifyInit/C_Verify with CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> and CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT (upstream context): positive cases must return CKR_OK, modified-message/modified-signature negatives CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID, too-small/too-large signatures CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE (PKCS#11 v3.2 5.1.6).
subset: 12 case(s) (upstream tcId 267, 268, 269, 271, 272, 273, 274, 275, 276, 277, 279, 280) taken from upstream tgId 20 (14 cases in that group; 504 in the upstream file).
field-drop: upstream fields not carried: deferred, sk, additionalRandomness

subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and size-budgeted. The two cheapest parameter sets (SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s and SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128s, 7856-byte signatures) contribute their WHOLE external/preHash sigVer group minus the cases whose hashAlg has no PKCS#11 mechanism - 12 cases each, keeping the upstream testPassed and reason verbatim. Between them they carry all six upstream negative reasons (modified message; modified signature - R / SIGHT / SIGFORS; invalid signature - too small / too large) in both hash families. The other ten parameter sets' preHash sigVer groups are listed in notExecuted with why=subset-size-budget (their signatures run 16 KB to 50 KB each; their positive-polarity verify coverage comes from verifying the upstream signatures carried by slhdsa_prehash_siggen_<family>_test.json). Cases whose hashAlg has no CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) and the internal-interface and external/pure groups are listed in notExecuted as metadata only. One file per SLH-DSA hash family.
A too-small / too-large signature must return CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE; any other invalid case CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID.

limitations: Upstream: SLH-DSA sigVer FIPS205 AFT (signatureInterface=external, preHash=preHash) → executed here: HashSLH-DSA SigVer via PKCS#11 C_VerifyInit/C_Verify with CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> and CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT (upstream context): positive cases must return CKR_OK, modified-message/modified-signature negatives CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID, too-small/too-large signatures CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE (PKCS#11 v3.2 5.1.6).
subset: 12 case(s) (upstream tcId 267, 268, 269, 271, 272, 273, 274, 275, 276, 277, 279, 280) taken from upstream tgId 20 (14 cases in that group; 504 in the upstream file).
field-drop: upstream fields not carried: deferred, sk, additionalRandomness

subset: Subset policy (file _provenance.subset_policy): Deterministic and size-budgeted. The two cheapest parameter sets (SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s and SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128s, 7856-byte signatures) contribute their WHOLE external/preHash sigVer group minus the cases whose hashAlg has no PKCS#11 mechanism - 12 cases each, keeping the upstream testPassed and reason verbatim. Between them they carry all six upstream negative reasons (modified message; modified signature - R / SIGHT / SIGFORS; invalid signature - too small / too large) in both hash families. The other ten parameter sets' preHash sigVer groups are listed in notExecuted with why=subset-size-budget (their signatures run 16 KB to 50 KB each; their positive-polarity verify coverage comes from verifying the upstream signatures carried by slhdsa_prehash_siggen_<family>_test.json). Cases whose hashAlg has no CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) and the internal-interface and external/pure groups are listed in notExecuted as metadata only. One file per SLH-DSA hash family.
A too-small / too-large signature must return CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE; any other invalid case CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID.
